name: Sproutling (Floral)
body:
Like a flower going dormant in the winter, you’ve learned to let go of your size.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Flora, size Medium or larger.

Benefit(s): With a moment of focus, your fibrous flesh twists and contracts. You gain the ability to shrink yourself as a standard action, as if with reduce person at will.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
